name: Esc stops the player but lets the key go on
why: The first Esc must stop the player and reach nothing else (the window, a card, a filter); the spec counts Esc keydowns that reach the document.
grep: Esc stops the player and nothing else sees it

name: a second video does not stop the first
why: Decision 4, one player at a time: the spec asserts a single frame after a second tile is clicked.

name: the still frame ignores sa_yt_stills
why: Stills off means no request to i.ytimg.com before a click; the spec counts them.
grep: nothing is asked before a click

name: a table tile plays under the tile, not in a row of its own
why: In a table the player is a full-width tr.mb-yt-playerrow under the row (the mockup); the spec asserts that row.
grep: in a table: a full-width row under the row

name: stopping unmarks only the tile that played
why: A re-render clones a marked source row; once the player is gone, the copy must not stay marked as playing.
grep: in a table: a full-width row under the row

name: a tile known dead still asks the player
why: A video the reader's oEmbed called dead shows the sentence and asks nothing; the spec asserts no frame and no request.

name: a frame-policy refusal is not remembered
why: Decision 6: after the refusal every tile says it opens YouTube and does so; the spec clicks a second tile and expects a new tab, no player.

name: the URLs table's converter adds no tile
why: Step 2: the tile is built with the URL cell in _eventRelColumns(); the spec asserts it under the link.
grep: the URLs sub-table: a tile under the link

name: the tile's words reach the filters
why: Without .mb-yt-tile in _CLEAN_STRIP_SEL a global filter for 'Play here' matches every row with a tile.
grep: the tile is out of every filter

name: the MusicBrainz page pass never runs
why: The sidebar's tile and the annotation's come from _ytDecorateMbPage() at init.

name: a heading's link gets its tile inside the heading
why: The heading's own text (read by the collapsible headings) must not gain the tile's; the spec asserts the tile right after the h2 and the h2's text unchanged.

edits.find: const at = head && root.contains(head) ? head : a;

grep: the annotation: a tile after the heading

name: the YouTube window has no tile
why: The link's window gets the same tile, playing in the window.

name: a window repaint replaces a playing player
why: Without _ytAreaRepaint() the window's repaint rebuilds its HTML and the video ends; the spec marks the frame and expects the same frame after the repaint.
